titulo: What the data do and do not say
intro: A practice report with made-up data teaches careful reading: samples, limits and cautious wording.
p.limitación.consejo: You say «las limitaciones del estudio». It is also a limit: «limitación de velocidad».
p.tendencia.consejo: You say «una tendencia al alza» (rising) and «a la baja» (falling). It is not a fixed rule.
p.informe.consejo: It is masculine: «un informe médico», «un informe de ventas».
p.relación.consejo: You say «relación entre A y B» or «relación con» something. «Relacionado con» is the adjective.
p.causa.consejo: Its opposite is «efecto» or «consecuencia». «A causa de» introduces the reason.
p.medición.consejo: It comes from «medir». You say «hacer una medición». You also say «medida».
p.prudencia.consejo: You say «con prudencia» and «pedir prudencia». The adjective is «prudente».
p.atribuir.consejo: It takes «a»: «atribuir un resultado a una causa». It conjugates like «construir»: «atribuyo».
p.sugerir.consejo: The e becomes ie or i: «sugiero», «sugirió». It is softer than «demostrar».
p.demostrar.consejo: The o becomes ue: «demuestro», «demuestras». It is stronger than «sugerir».
p.generalizar.consejo: The z changes to c: «generalice». Avoid generalising from little data.
p.advertir.consejo: The e becomes ie or i: «advierto», «advirtió». You warn about a danger or a limit.
b1.titulo: A result is not yet a cause
b1.texto:
**A practice report.** The data in this lesson are invented. When reading a **informe**, look at **what was measured**, **in whom** and **what the results allow us to say**.

**Cautious words.** **Se observó**, **los datos sugieren**, **podría estar relacionado con**: they say there is a **relación**, but not that it is the **causa**. Data **sugieren**; they do not **demuestran**.

**The limits.** Look for **limitaciones**: few plants, little time or no comparison group. With that you cannot **generalizar**.

**Headline and report.** A headline can say more than the report. The authors **advierten** about their limits and ask for **prudencia**.
b2.f0.texto: The headline says the sun improves every vegetable garden.
b2.f1.texto: The report only measured twelve pots over four weeks.
b2.f2.texto: With such a small sample you cannot generalise.
b2.f3.texto: Besides, the watering and the temperature changed.
b2.f4.texto: The data suggest a link, but do not prove it.
b2.f5.texto: Then the headline should speak with more caution.
b2.f6.texto: I suggest writing that light could be related to growth.
b2.f7.texto: That way we do not attribute the cause to the sun without evidence.
b4.texto:
**Soft and strong verbs.** **Sugerir**, **indicar** and **parecer** leave the doubt open; **demostrar** and **probar** close it. A careful report uses the first.

**Poder + estar relacionado con.** **Podría estar relacionado con** says it is possible, not certain.

**Se + verb** gives the fact without saying who: **se observó**, **se registró**.

**No se puede afirmar que + subjunctive**: **No se puede afirmar que el sol sea la causa.**

**Mientras que** and **en cambio** set two facts against each other: **En ocho macetas se observó más crecimiento, mientras que en las otras cuatro no hubo cambios.**
b4.e0.texto: The data suggest a possible link.
b4.e1.texto: It cannot be claimed that the sun is the cause.
b4.e2.texto: In eight pots more growth was observed, while in the other four there were no changes.
b5.f0.texto: Twelve clay pots wait in a row on the greenhouse table.
b5.f1.texto: In each one grows a young green tomato plant.
b5.f2.texto: A researcher measures each stem with a transparent plastic ruler.
b5.f3.texto: The morning sun comes in through the glass and warms the highest leaves.
b5.f4.texto: Every week she writes the numbers on a squared sheet.
b5.f5.texto: A shiny headline promises that the sun improves every vegetable garden in the world.
b5.f6.texto: The report, quieter, only talks about its twelve pots.
b5.f7.texto: Its authors doubt in a soft voice and write cautious words.
b5.f8.texto: The data point to a narrow path between shade and light.
b5.f9.texto: Whoever reads calmly learns to distrust overly sure sentences.
b6.o0: el crecimiento de todos los huertos
b6.o0.refuerzo: The headline says that, not the report.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Yes: the report only measured those twelve pots.
b6.pregunta: What did the report directly measure?
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Demostrar» is stronger: the report asks for more evidence.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Garantizar» is even stronger; it does not fit a possible link.
b8.frase: El informe pide prudencia antes de generalizar
b8.traduccion: The report asks for caution before generalising
b9.o0.refuerzo: The material of the pots is not the limit the report mentions.
b9.o2: La muestra es pequeña y cambió el riego
b9.o2.refuerzo: Yes: few pots and other changes prevent talking about a cause.
b9.pregunta: Why is the difference not attributed only to the sun?
b11.frase: No se puede afirmar que el sol ____ la causa.
b11.o0.refuerzo: That is indicative; the negation takes the subjunctive.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «no se puede afirmar que» + subjunctive.
b11.o2.refuerzo: That is future; after «que» comes the subjunctive.
b11.pregunta: Which form does «no se puede afirmar que» take?
b12.o0: El sol mejora todos los huertos del mundo
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it says it holds for all, and only twelve pots were measured.
b12.o1: El sol parece relacionado con el crecimiento
b12.o1.refuerzo: It is cautious: it says «parece», not «es».
b12.o2: En doce macetas las plantas crecieron más
b12.o2.refuerzo: It sticks to what was measured: twelve pots.
p.huertos.consejo: Plural of «huerto», a small plot for growing vegetables.
p.midió.consejo: Past of «medir», third person: the «ó» takes the stress.
p.cambiaron.consejo: Third person plural of «cambiar» in the past.
p.sugieren.consejo: Third person plural of «sugerir», with the e → ie stem change.
p.demuestran.consejo: Third person plural of «demostrar», to prove something.
p.relacionada.consejo: Feminine of «relacionado», connected to something else.
p.crecimiento.consejo: The growth of a plant or a company, from «crecer».
p.atribuimos.consejo: Present of «atribuir» for «nosotros»; it takes «a» before the cause.
p.observó.consejo: Past of «observar», to watch closely; the «ó» takes the stress.
p.invernadero.consejo: A glass house where plants grow in warm air.
p.tomatera.consejo: The plant that gives tomatoes; «tomate» is the fruit.
p.mide.consejo: Third person of «medir», to measure, in the present.
p.tallo.consejo: The stem holds up the leaves of a plant.
p.regla.consejo: A «regla» is a ruler; it also means a rule.
p.cuadriculada.consejo: Feminine of «cuadriculado», with small squares like graph paper.
p.autores.consejo: Plural of «autor», the person who writes a work.
p.dudan.consejo: Third person plural of «dudar», to be unsure.
p.señalan.consejo: Third person plural of «señalar», to point out; the «ñ» is «ny».
p.desconfiar.consejo: «Des-» means not and «confiar» means to trust.
